messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - east1 GPU pool 'primary-render' saturated, queue growth > 18k requests, autoscaler failing. Errors in autoscaler logs: quota_exceeded and scale_attempt_timeout. Several customers reporting 429s/503s via support hook. Initiating cross-region spillover to eu-west; fallback routes may be congested. Please acknowledge and triage.

Priya (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Paging SREs, handing to Jordan to lead mitigation. Will update severity on incidents page.

Jordan: Oncall here — joining. First checks: is autoscaler hitting cloud quota or internal max_nodes? @deploy-bot can you paste the last scale event?

deploy-bot: scale-event: {pool: primary-render, region: east1, desired: 64, attempted: 64, result: FAILED, reason: quota_exceeded}. Recent API errors: 429 from router, 503 from model-proxy at 10:12:03.

Jordan: OK quota_exceeded. That explains why autoscaler retries and then timeouts. Sam — I saw spillover to eu-west started automatically. What's eu-west headroom?

Sam: eu-west currently at 85% GPU utilization across standard pools. Warm pool for spillover is small (10 nodes). We diverted low-priority traffic, but the incoming rate is too high; queue on eu-west is now growing too. We have two levers: 1) throttle low-priority and internal traffic, 2) route to a dedicated burst pool (if we can spin one up).

Leo: I can request and provision a temporary dedicated burst pool in eu-west but cloud quota will block if nodes > project quota. I can request quota bump but that takes time. Quick option: use preemptible/spot instances for burst pool (lower reliability) — should be allowed within current quotas.

Anika: Suggest degrade model variant for non-critical routes (e.g., use small-quantized variant) to reduce GPU memory/latency. We can flip routing for 'default' to 'variant-small' for 30 mins. That would cut per-request GPU usage ~45%.

Jordan: Good. Plan: 1) throttle non-prod/internal keys to 10% of baseline now. 2) Switch non-promoted routes to variant-small. 3) Create spot burst pool in eu-west for low-priority spillover. 4) Open ticket with cloud for quota bump (Leo). 5) Notify Support/Customers on status page. Tasks assigned below.

Priya (oncall): I'll run the throttles and compose the status update. Jordan, can you do the variant flip and burst pool provisioning? Sam/Leo help with routing and pool ops.

Jordan: Starting variant flip for non-critical routes. Patch:

```json
{
  "route": "default",
  "condition": "!is_premium",
  "model_variant": "gptx-small-quant",
  "timeout": "30m"
}
```

Jordan: Applied. Monitoring token usage. Early metric: avg GPU memory per request down ~42%.

Priya (oncall): Throttle script (running):

```bash
# throttle non-prod API keys to 10%
redwoodctl quotas set --scope=nonprod --rate=0.1
```

Priya (oncall): Done. Internal test traffic dropped ~78% so far. Queue for high-priority customers still growing but slower.

Sam: I started provisioning spot burst pool in eu-west: pool id burst-eu-spot-01. Attempting attach to spillover routing. If attach fails, we'll fall back to increasing routing weight to dedicated east1-burst (if healthy).

deploy-bot: pool-create: burst-eu-spot-01 created (pending). attach-status: ATTACH_FAILED - networkSubnetQuotaExceeded.

Leo: Network subnet quota issue — I can patch a temporary NAT rule and carve out a subnet from our spare CIDR. Doing now. ETA ~8-12 minutes.

Jordan: While we wait, enable degraded routing policy to favor eu-west only for premium customers, keep all best-effort to east1 and drop everything else. Command:

```bash
redwoodctl routing update --from=east1 --to=eu-west --policy="premium-only,warm-pool-preference"
```

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: when autoscaler fails with quota_exceeded: 1) Pause new allocations via route-level throttles, 2) divert non-essential traffic, 3) attempt spot/ephemeral pools, 4) escalate quota with cloud provider, 5) if all else fails, enable degraded model fallback and set customer-facing degrade message.

Support Team: Noting customer impact: 17 customers reported errors (mix of 429/503), highest impact on real-time chat integrations. We'll post a status page update: "Partial service degradation in east1; mitigation in progress; some requests may see increased latency or degraded model output." Priya please include ETA estimate.

Priya (oncall): ETA: 30-45 minutes to stabilize with variant flips + throttles + spot pool (assuming subnet patch succeeds). Posting status now.

Support Team: Posting done. Added link to internal incident doc and clarified which customers affected. Recommend targeted outreach to top 5 customers after stabilization.

Jordan: Confirming metrics: east1 queue length peaked at 18.6k -> down to 8.9k after throttles + variant flip. eu-west queue bumped from 1.2k -> 3.4k. Burst-eu attach shows pending (Leo update needed).

Leo: Subnet carve-out applied. Retrying attach.

deploy-bot: attach-status: ATTACH_SUCCESS for burst-eu-spot-01. Routing weights updated to include burst-eu-spot-01 for low-priority.

Sam: Good catch. Low-priority traffic now draining to burst-eu-spot-01. Overall request latency improved ~28% for degraded variant, error rate down from 4.7% -> 1.2%.

Jordan: Ok status: primary issue (autoscaler hit quota) mitigated by throttling + variant degrade + spot burst pool. Autoscaler still showing repeated failed attempts; need long-term fix: increase project GPU quota or move some stateful workloads to Dedicated capacity.

Priya (oncall): Raising follow-ups: 1) Leo to request permanent quota bump with cloud provider (owner: Leo). 2) Product/Platform evaluate dedicated reserved pool for high-SLA customers (owner: Jordan). 3) Ops to add subnet pre-provision step to regional warm pool playbook (owner: Sam). 4) Support to run outreach to top 5 customers (owner: Support Team). 5) Create postmortem doc (owner: Priya).

Anika: Also propose an automatic early-warning alert for warm-pool headroom < 20% so we can pre-scale before spillover. I'll draft alert.

Priya (oncall): Logging final summary into incident tracker and setting severity to P2 now as visible customer impact reduced. Will keep thread open for postmortem notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Leaving a short timeline note for the postmortem: - 10:08 autoscaler first fail (quota_exceeded), - 10:14 automatic spillover started, - 10:22 throttles + variant flips initiated, - 10:35 spot pool attached and draining, - 11:02 error rate <1.5%.

Support Team: We'll keep monitoring and do follow-up outreach. Closing out oncall handoff in 30m.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded. Link: internal/incidents/2123456789.

Priya (oncall): Postmortem todo: include metrics, commands used, timelines, and runbook edits. I'll kick this off tomorrow.

Jordan: +1. Also recommend a short engineering ticket to make 'variant-small' automatically eligible as a graceful fallback for non-premium routes when spillover triggers.

Sam: Copy. Will add runbook edits and alerting changes.

Leo: I'll start quota request now and attach the support ticket to the incident.

Anika: Thanks team. Good coordination.

Support Team: :white_check_mark:
